question: Based on our customer pizza order information, summarize the total quantity of each ingredient used in the pizzas we delivered. Output the name and quantity for each ingredient.
sql:
WITH delivered_orders AS (
    SELECT po.pizza_id
    FROM pizza_customer_orders po
    JOIN pizza_runner_orders pr ON po.order_id = pr.order_id
    WHERE pr.cancellation IS NULL
),
pizza_topping_details AS (
    SELECT od.pizza_id, rt.toppings
    FROM delivered_orders od
    JOIN pizza_recipes rt ON od.pizza_id = rt.pizza_id
),
expanded_toppings AS (
    SELECT pizza_id, topping_id
    FROM pizza_topping_details
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(ARRAY(SELECT REGEXP_SPLIT_TO_TABLE(toppings, ','))) as t(topping_id)
)
SELECT * FROM expanded_toppings
